strings.name: Dan Carter
strings.role: Rugby union fly-half · Former All Black
strings.summary: Carter's playmaking, tactical kicking and goalkicking made him a central All Blacks fly-half, scoring 1598 points in 112 Tests. He belonged to the 2011 and 2015 World Cup-winning squads, although injury ended his 2011 tournament before the knockout stages; he played a decisive role in the 2015 final. He also played in France and Japan and later supported players' transitions beyond professional rugby.

strings.timeline.t5.title: World Cup and player award

strings.timeline.t6.title: World Cup squad and injury
strings.timeline.t6.text: Part of the winning squad, but a groin injury ended his tournament early.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Lions series and player award

strings.timeline.t8.title: All Blacks debut
strings.timeline.t8.text: Scored 20 points against Wales on Test debut, later becoming first-choice fly-half.

strings.timeline.t9.text: Entered Canterbury's senior side, joining the Crusaders the next year.
